page.overview:
Who is Harold Trumble?

Harold Trumble was a mental patient at Grace Andersen Sanitarium. He had an obsession with serial killers such as John Wayne Gacy, Ted Bundy and Michael Myers (whom he idolized). He had the habit of escaping his room, but he was harmless and on good terms with the security guards. On October 31, 2001, Harold had managed to escape once again and was wearing a clown mask, trying to be like Gacy. Willie Haines escorted Harold back inside his room.

A couple of minutes later, Harold saw a shadowy figure walk past his room and, later in the night, that same figure came into his room. The figure was Michael Myers, who handed Harold his bloody knife (thus incriminating him for murdering Laurie Strode and the officers Haines and Franklin Munroe) and then left the room while Harold told himself the history of Michael, overjoyed that Michael had come out of hiding.
